# An explicit ambiguous selector remains an error.
! exec card --store shared-store --board Shared web --port 0 --no-browser
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/ambiguous-board.txt

# Without an explicit or checkout-bound selection, the browser chooses scope
# from the complete catalog and startup does not create a binding.
! exists .cardamom-board
exec sh probe-web.sh unbound-catalog.json
cmpjson unbound-catalog.json $WORK/golden/unbound-catalog.json
! exists .cardamom-board

# A checkout binding remains the server default.
exec card --store shared-store board use board_11111111111111111111
exec sh probe-web.sh bound-catalog.json
cmpjson bound-catalog.json $WORK/golden/bound-catalog.json

-- probe-web.sh --
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

card --store "$PWD/shared-store" web \
  --bind 127.0.0.1 \
  --port 0 \
  --no-browser >web.out 2>web.err &
pid=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

i=0
url=
while [ "$i" -lt 100 ]; do
  url=$(sed -n 's/^web application available at //p' web.out | head -n 1)
  [ -n "$url" ] && break
  if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    cat web.err >&2
    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 1
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 0.02
done
[ -n "$url" ]

i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 100 ]; do
  if curl --fail --silent --request POST \
    --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --header 'Connect-Protocol-Version: 1' \
    --data '{}' \
    "$url/cardamom.private.v1.ProjectService/GetBootstrap" >bootstrap.json; then
    break
  fi
  if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    cat web.err >&2
    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 1
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 0.02
done

jq '{
  projects: (.projects // []),
  boards: (.boards // []),
  serverDefaultBoardId: (.serverDefaultBoardId // null)
}' bootstrap.json >"$1"

kill -TERM "$pid"
wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
trap - EXIT

-- golden/ambiguous-board.txt --
error: board "Shared" is ambiguous; use an ID
